Full skill text at 5★
Deals (300% of Icefield Ghost's ATK + 75000) DMG to all enemies. Removes all buffs from 2 enemies who have dealt the highest DMG in total. Afterward, inflicts [Preying Wolves] on the enemies for 2 turns and extends all of their debuffs by 1 turn. Reduces Shielded Effect and Healed Effect by 50% for the enemies with [Preying Wolves]. Also, reduces Max HP of all enemies (excluding Boss) by 15%.
Source: game files.
